status: Requirements only; no physical execution, hardware test, or simulation
required_edges: stock -> fabrication job -> sample -> protected carrier
service readiness -> calibration epoch -> detector configuration
pattern manifest + run + configuration -> each raw measurement
raw measurement pair -> signed Hadamard coefficient
raw measurement set + correction map + software/weights -> reconstruction
reconstruction + held-out reference + metric/uncertainty policy -> evaluation
all successful and failed branches -> final archive manifest
derived_records: Version every correction, registration, reconstruction and metric; never overwrite raw signals
cross_device_contract: DMD display IDs, controller event counters and detector records must agree. A FIFO claim alone does not prove current instrument synchronization; explicit consistency receipts are mandatory.
authored_timestamp_convention: Synthetic guard raw event time is exposure start. Complete [time,time+exposure] must lie within current readiness validity. A later readiness check cannot retroactively qualify expired raw events.
